scripts.bootstrap: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'start'], { cwd: 'server', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'client', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
